name: mid_body_edit
description: Predict ONLY the single line that changed inside a function body (the finish_block counter-skill: one edit mid-function, never re-complete or re-emit the function). Deterministic corpus-side mutations of normalized CRAN functions (3+ body lines, highest version per package, the build_astfim versions.json pattern): a call's constant argument edited, na.rm = TRUE inserted into a mean/sd/var/median call, one declared local renamed at exactly ONE mid-body occurrence, or one attested neighbour assignment inserted with a fresh LHS. Suffix convention per the scope-aware-context rule (docs/prompt-format.md): prefix = file context through the function opening plus the body down to the mutation site (cursor at the end of the typed line before the change); suffix = the post-change remainder of the function through its closing brace plus a window of file-below lines, so the whole function stays visible; target = the one changed/new line.
novelty_note: No existing family edits a line that sits mid-function with the function's remainder pinned in the suffix: finish_block ends at the cursor with no suffix and rewards completing everything; the scenario propagation families (rename/pipe/na_rm) re-emit a region driven by an event diff, which the cases harness forbids. Here the exact gate is fully deterministic and corpus-side (mock backend, namespace_qualify convention): the model draw is only a structural floor (mid_body_edit_line: <=3 lines, one clean tree-sitter statement - no full-function re-emission); the row_check re-derives the mutation from the carried pre-edit corpus_line with the scenarios transformation asserts (single-token constant edit / na.rm insertion before the close paren / valid rename pair / attested-pattern insert) and verifies the typed-partial prefix tail plus the closing brace in the suffix. insert_line (variant d) keeps exactness by construction: the new line is a verbatim corpus-attested same-function assignment with only the LHS swapped to a fresh non-colliding name (derive_new_name), so every RHS variable exists in the visible function.

provenance.license: CRAN package sources (per-package licenses, mostly GPL-3/MIT)
provenance.note: normalized CRAN corpus (/mnt/h/sepalith/normalized), highest version per package; tidy-pool + random top-up (na.rm density); one deterministic mid-body mutation per function

difficulty.knobs: body length (min_body_lines..max_body_lines of the corpus selector) and mutation kind (arg_edit / na_rm_insert / rename_once / insert_line)
